items.title: Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Micron, Roblox, Reddit, SK Hynix, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: It’s looking like a positive end to a bad month as stocks rose Friday with the tech rebound continuing even as  Apple  decline weighed on the major indexes.  Amazon  gained 15% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.  Alphabet  and  Meta Platforms  were both punished by the market after hiking capex this earnings season.

items.title: AMD is Down 10% Over a Month: Did Microsoft’s Catalyst Just Spark the 155% Upside Expected By Wall Street Pro?
items.summary: Baird just set the highest AMD price target on Wall Street after a brutal July selloff, and a surprise Microsoft announcement may have handed AMD the exact catalyst needed to justify it.

items.title: Should You Buy AMD Stock Ahead of Q2 Earnings? Here's What to Know
items.summary: AMD heads into Q2 earnings with robust EPYC, Instinct and Ryzen AI demand, but a lofty valuation and fierce competition temper its growth outlook.

items.title: Rivian Sinks 8% Despite Q2 Beat and Raised Guidance; Lucid Falls 6%
items.summary: Rivian just posted its cleanest quarterly beat in months and lifted full-year guidance, so why are shareholders waking up to an 8% drop while Lucid bleeds in sympathy and Tesla quietly holds its ground?

items.title: Qualcomm Stock's Biggest Risk Is The Gap Between Pain And Payoff
items.summary: Just over half of revenue still leans on a shrinking handset market, and the businesses meant to replace it do not reach their targeted scale for years.

items.title: AMD Stock Is Up Big, and Wall Street Is Underestimating It
items.summary: AMD has surged over 100% this year, then gave back 22% in a single week, leaving investors wondering whether the selloff is a warning or an opportunity. The answer hinges on a handful of AI commitments that Wall Street may not be pricing correctly.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Apple, Amazon, SK Hynix, Roblox
items.summary: ↗️ SK Hynix (KR:000660), Samsung (KR:005930): Shares of both chipmakers surged over 25% in Asian trading, staging a strong recovery after a turbulent week. U.S.-listed peers Marvell (MRVL) and Intel (INTC) also moved higher.

items.title: Intel Stock's Operating Margin Turned Positive While Its Foundry Kept Losing Money
items.summary: Intel swung from an operating loss to an operating profit with the costly part of its turnaround still running, and that swing is what the spending debate keeps drowning out.
